title: ASD LabSpec 4 high-res -> standard-res, v0.3 (general method: datasheet blur per detector, absorbance gain per detector fitted on the collagen bands, visible levels fitted)

operator.note: inside each detector segment of the scan's own joins (the join wavelength belongs to the lower segment); taps to radius ceil(4 sigma), renormalised within the segment, never crossing a join; sigma from the published bandwidths (FWHM 10 nm standard vs 6 nm high-res in SWIR; VNIR equal)

A = log10(1/max(R, 1e-6)); A' = g*A + c per detector segment (VNIR, SWIR1, SWIR2); R' = 10^(-A'). Derivative-based outputs (models, bands, contaminant signs) ignore the offsets; the heat check reads reflectance levels (visible reflectance and the visible edge against 1250-1300 nm), so the offsets matter there and are fitted.

provenance.summary: General paired-scan method (DECISIONS 137): blur the high-res scan per detector by the datasheet sigma; fit one absorbance gain per SWIR detector by zero-intercept least squares between the mean SG31 cubic second derivative of the standard-res scans and of the blurred high-res scans over the collagen bands (N-H 1545, C-H 1689/1728; N-H 2044, amide 2175, 2262 +-25 nm); pairs whose standard reading is below 6% are checks, never fitted; pairs with too little band structure or single-pair gains far from the rest are set aside. The VNIR gain and offset are fitted on 450-950 nm and each SWIR offset as a level fit (1100-1750, 1850-2250 nm). The settings were chosen by a pre-registered selection rule (written and hashed before any comparison was computed; decision_rule_sha256) on 36 concordant paired LabSpec 4 high-res / standard-res scans, leave-one-bone-out of the whole build: verdict, band-state and heat agreement with the standard-resolution partners first, then the CONS3 error at the low end (standard CONS3 below 4%), then 4-6% and overall; the datasheet blur was preferred over a learned one for this file (Matt, 2026-10-19).

fitted_on.description: concordant high-res / standard-res scan pairs of the same archaeological bones, two unit pairs

provenance.gain_bootstrap_note: 400 of 400 resamples of bones, the whole build re-run (selection included)
